verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel's own site has visa-information pages for nonimmigrant visas ("the most common visa types our employment-based clients obtain") and immigrant visas ("the most common routes to permanent residency"), plus a start-up practice and a J-1 incubator founder pathway. The provided evidence never names O-1, H-1B, cap-exempt H-1B, E-2 or TN, and choosing a route is deferred to a consultation rather than covered in the materials. missing for 10: explicit coverage of O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2 and TN; detail on the specific founder green-card paths; written guidance on choosing the right visa; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation

citations.quote: We have attached the key provisions relating to the most common visa types our employment-based clients obtain.
